_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written from scratch for Raptor.
name: Minecraft: Endstone
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Endstone, Mojang's own Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server with a plugin loader for Python and C++ plugins. Installs any Endstone release and the Bedrock server it supports, keeping worlds and settings when it updates.
startup: v="$(cat .endstone-version) $(python3 --version)"; if [ "$v" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Endstone $(cat .endstone-version)"; { python3 -m venv --clear .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check "endstone==$(cat .endstone-version)" && echo "$v" > .venv/.raptor-installed; } || exit 1; fi; h=$(echo .venv/lib/python3*/site-packages/endstone/crashpad_handler*); h=${h%.off}; if [ "{{CRASH_REPORTS}}" = true ]; then [ -e "$h" ] || mv -f "$h.off" "$h"; elif [ -e "$h" ]; then mv -f "$h" "$h.off"; fi; mkdir -p plugins/bstats; b=plugins/bstats/config.toml; touch $b; if ! grep -q "^server-uuid" $b; then read -r u < /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid; echo "server-uuid = \"$u\"" >> $b; fi; if grep -q "^enabled" $b; then sed -i "s/^enabled.*/enabled = {{BSTATS}}/" $b; else echo "enabled = {{BSTATS}}" >> $b; fi; exec .venv/bin/python -m endstone -s . -y

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Endstone. Checks the chosen Endstone version on PyPI. Endstone
# is installed when the server starts, into its own Python environment
# (.venv) for the Python the server runs, and it downloads the Bedrock
# server it supports from Mojang, checked against its checksum. Worlds,
# plugins and settings are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# Endstone and Mojang's server are built for x86-64 only.
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "Endstone only runs on x86-64 servers, and this one is $(uname -m)."

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
want="${ENDSTONE_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    url=https://pypi.org/pypi/endstone/json
else
    url="https://pypi.org/pypi/endstone/$want/json"
fi
code=$(curl -sSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o /tmp/endstone.json -w '%{http_code}' "$url") || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 404 ] && fail "Endstone has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.11.15."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now (HTTP $code). Reinstall to try again."
version=$(jq -r .info.version /tmp/endstone.json)
jq -e 'any(.urls[]; .filename | test("manylinux.*x86_64\\.whl$"))' /tmp/endstone.json >/dev/null ||
    fail "Endstone $version has no Linux build. Choose another version."
echo "$version" > .endstone-version
mkdir -p plugins
echo "Installed Endstone $version. It's set up, with the Bedrock server it supports, when the server first starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Endstone release, such as 0.11.15, or latest for the newest one. Each release runs one Bedrock version. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in their server list.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: The game mode new players start in: survival, creative or adventure.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: The world's difficulty: peaceful, easy, normal or hard.

variables.name: Cheats
variables.description: Whether commands such as /gamemode and /give work for operators: true or false.

variables.name: Usage statistics
variables.description: Send anonymous statistics about the server to bStats.org, where its developers see them (true or false).

variables.name: Crash reports
variables.description: Send each start and any crash report to Endstone's developers (true or false).
